schema.description: CompareSessionTemplateResponse contains both the snapshot and current template configurations.

changedVariableKeys.description:
Keys of template variables whose values differ between snapshot and current.
Only the keys are returned; actual values are never exposed.

current.description: Current template configuration (null if the template is deleted).

coldBoot.description:
Boot the emulator cold (-no-snapshot-load) and never save a quickboot
snapshot, so every boot is a full first boot.

cores.description:
Emulator CPU core count. 0 = sized to the host (cores/2, clamped to
[2, 4]). The VM clamps out-of-range values, always leaving the host a core.

deviceProfile.description: avdmanager device profile (for example, "pixel_7"). Empty = platform default.

ramMb.description:
Emulator RAM in MB. 0 = sized to the host (RAM/4, clamped to [2048, 6144]).
The VM clamps out-of-range values to what the host can spare.

systemImage.description:
sdkmanager system image package (for example,
"system-images;android-36;google_apis_ps16k;x86_64"). Empty = platform default.

androidEmulatorEnabled.description: Whether the Android emulator capability is declared/enabled.

items.description: TemplateConfigFlag represents a feature flag for comparison.

enabled.description: Whether this flag is enabled by default.

items.description: SnapshotPort represents an exposed service port captured at session creation time.

description.description: Description shown next to the tunnel help.

localPort.description: Suggested local port for the tunnel. 0 means "same as port".

name.description: Short name of the service (for example, "web-app").

port.description: Port the service listens on inside the VM.

sessionInputs.description: Session input definitions (keys and metadata, not actual values).

items.description: TemplateConfigInput represents a session input definition for comparison.

exposeAsEnvVar.description: Whether this input is exposed as an environment variable.

isSecret.description: Whether this input is a secret.

stackId.description:
Stack id (for example, "osx-xcode-16.0.x-edge"). The stable contract; distinguishes
stack-only changes that resolve to the same provisionable image.

templateVariables.description: Template variable keys and metadata (secret values stripped).

items.description:
TemplateConfigVariable represents a template variable for comparison.
Secret values are never exposed — only key and metadata.

exposeAsEnvVar.description: Whether this variable is exposed as an environment variable.

isSecret.description: Whether this variable is a secret.

updatedAt.description: When the template was last updated.

items.description: SnapshotLink represents a workspace link captured at session creation time.

snapshot.description: Template configuration from the session's snapshot (at creation time).
